_comment: Tier -> model mapping per runtime. Edit here to change models everywhere; then rerun scripts/build_subagents.py. 'verified' = model ID checked against provider docs on 2026-10-17. 'tested' = the tier was benchmarked with this model in the blackboard expert bench.

tiers.deep: Judgment-heavy roles: finding the decisive insight, falsifying the front-runner, designing sound experiments, one-way architecture decisions.
tiers.standard: Roles where precision matters (security, money, data, contracts, test design) but the work is mostly structured.
tiers.fast: Procedural roles: structured specs, checklists, state coverage, mapping.

claude._doc: Claude Code subagent frontmatter `model` (aliases or full IDs). https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents

openrouter._doc: OpenRouter model slugs. `models` lists the primary first, then fallbacks (OpenRouter tries them in order).
